blind.description: A stylized classical garden urn mounted on a square stone pedestal. The urn has two ornate scroll handles on opposing sides and is filled with a dense mound of blooming red and pastel yellow flowers among leafy green vines, some of which drape over the moss-stained stone rim. Surfaces are solid, stylized, and continuous with hand-painted moss textures over aged sandstone.
blind.from_above: A dense circular bunch of red and pale yellow flowers nestled in green foliage, flanked by two pale stone scroll handles extending to the left and right.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.8 ft tall (just under half the height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 2.5 ft wide across the handles.
